definitions.explanation: Having qualities that give great pleasure to the senses or mind. A more literary and formal word for beauty compared to きれい.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{夕日|ゆうひ}ですね。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{美|うつく}しい{人|ひと}です。
{日本|にほん}の{自然|しぜん}は{美|うつく}しい。

notes:
美しい conjugates as an i-adjective: 美しくない (negative), 美しくて (te-form), 美しかった (past). This is more literary/formal than きれい (which is also used for 'clean'). 美しい has a deeper, more aesthetic connotation and is used in poetry and formal contexts.

Related: 美しさ (うつくしさ - beauty, noun).
